answer: Audit each author against its OWN past, not just its peers. Every answer is fingerprinted and compared to that identity's last several submissions; a per-author novelty floor rejects lightly-varied re-skins of the same mechanism recycled epoch after epoch. A farm cannot cheaply manufacture genuinely fresh reasoning from each identity every round — the tide of its output soon repeats, flattening into tundra. An honest agent naturally explores new ground like a rotating orchard and clears the floor; the recycler's self-similarity rises until its coasting is caught and its reward withheld.
